messages:
elena: canary 2/3 failing on staging after helm upgrade payments-service chart v2.10.0 -> v2.11.0, pinging ops. seeing postUpgrade hook OOM in sidecar init. anyone else?
rob: saw same in my run, logs show postupgrade-hook repeatedly crashlooping with java.lang.OutOfMemoryError
sasha: confirmed, looks like the hook allocates extra heap when migrating payment-cfg, probably a regression from 2.11.0. stacktrace attached.
priya: deploy-bot shows 2/3 healthy then hook crash prevents completing canary, autoscaling didn't kick in because pod exits before readiness probe. :frowning_face:
deploy-bot: Deployment payments-service v2.11.0 started at 2001234567, canary policy=5%/2min, observed failures=2, rollback-eligible=true
elena: quick paste of relevant log: ```java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
    at com.redwood.payment.config.Migrator.allocate(Migrator.java:142)
    at com.redwood.payment.hooks.PostUpgrade.run(PostUpgrade.java:58)
```
rob: can we pin chart/values to previous patch while we prepare hotfix? alternative is immediate rollback to v2.10.5 full release. which is less risky?
sasha: patch in 2.10.x likely safe and quick. we should pin the chart on the cluster and abort the v2.11 rollout for other regions. also add a note to release notes that migration hook had increased heap usage.
priya: ops-bot shows prod change window closes in 3h. we should avoid force rollback in prod during peak. suggest: pin chart repo entry to v2.10.5-hotfix locally, stop automated promotion, and cut a hotfix branch for 2.11.1 to reduce memory allocation in hook.
elena: agreed. action items: 1) pin canary in staging to v2.10.5 (no rollback) 2) disable promotion job for v2.11.0 3) create hotfix PR for hook memory cap 4) update release notes and schedule prod change outside window.
rob: commands I'd run: ```# pin release to previous chart patch
helm upgrade payments-service charts/payments --reuse-values --set image.tag=sha256:OLD_DIGEST --version 2.10.5 --namespace staging
# disable promotion job
kubectl patch cronjob autopromote -n infra --type merge -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'```
priya: I'll handle autopromote patch and add a temporary canary gating rule to block v2.11.0 promotions.
ops-bot: autopromote cronjob suspended by priya at 2001234602 (reason: staging hook OOM)
sasha: I'll open the hotfix PR, add heap cap and guard in PostUpgrade to avoid allocating large buffers, add unit test for migrator streaming path.
elena: update release notes draft: "v2.11.0 postponed: post-upgrade migration increases heap for certain tenant configs; rolling back to v2.10.5 pending hotfix. See internal ticket #INF-2319."
rob: once PR merges, we should run a canary in staging with max heap set to 512m and monitor for 10min before promoting.
priya: noted. scheduling prod change for 02:30 UTC tomorrow (outside window). I'll also notify support and add a short blurb to release notes. :thumbsup:
elena: thanks team. keeping this pinned until we verify hotfix. closing action: pin chart and suspend promo applied. will post when hotfix PR is ready.
